Product Features

  • Integrated Wall Cabinet Design: Total dimensions 245 x 30 x 170 cm, creating a complete TV background wall with integrated wall cabinet. This provides a complete solution for storage and decoration in the living room and makes the room look neater and more spacious.
  • Double-sided storage: One side features a double cabinet design, with one side being a closed storage cabinet with a transparent acrylic door, and the other side featuring a multi-layered open grid that combines item storage with display features for clearer categorization.
  • Multi-layered open display space: The openwork side cabinet is divided into 4 shelves where books, decorations, green plants, collectibles, etc. can be freely placed to create a customized display wall and show off your home taste.
  • Extension of the top shelf: Equipped with a 170 cm shelf at the top, it can accommodate picture frames, decorative boxes, books, etc., making the most of the space on the wall, expanding the storage and display area.
  • Extra large storage space in the base cabinet: The TV cabinet is equipped with two folding doors and offers extra large storage space inside, where audiovisual equipment, sundries, snacks, etc. can be stored. So clutter disappears perfectly and the living room remains tidy.
  • High Gloss Textured Finish: The entire piece of furniture is finished with a high gloss finish, creating a clear and stylish pure white exterior. The transparent acrylic door gives a sense of openness and exudes luxury, making it suitable for various interior styles, including modern and minimalist luxury.
  • High-quality materials guaranteed: The construction made of MDF boards is robust and durable. The total recommended load capacity is 30kg, the recommended load capacity of the top shelf is 10kg, ensuring worry-free daily use.
  • Flexible Layout Design: The combination of open shelves, closed cabinets, and hinged doors can be flexibly customized to meet the storage and display needs of different items, maximizing practicality.
  • Aesthetics and functionality combined: The integrated design ensures a harmonious overall appearance of the TV back wall and at the same time serves as a generously sized storage system and aesthetic eye-catcher in the living room, effortlessly enhancing the style of your home.
  • Note: This product is shipped in 2 packages and can be delivered in multiple partial deliveries. Please make sure you have received all the packages before you start building!
